# Release check: 2026-11-27, v1.2.0

A fresh agent with no context installed v1.2.0 from GitHub and followed only the README and `docs/installation.md`. It chose its own spec: the Ably Platform API 1.1.0 from the [APIs.guru OpenAPI Directory](https://github.com/APIs-guru/openapi-directory/blob/main/APIs/ably.io/platform/1.1.0/openapi.yaml), 22 operations. That spec is now a test fixture.

What worked: install, `help`, `init`, `generate` and `validate` ran without errors; all 22 operations were generated; server URL and `security: []` were handled; validation output named what it checked and exited non-zero on failure; a hand-written doc from a template passed first time; the CI step ran locally.

| Finding | Outcome in v1.2.1 |
| --- | --- |
| Freshly generated docs failed the OpenAPI check on `oneOf` request bodies | Fixed: the check accepts every shape of a `oneOf` or `anyOf` |
| `oneOf` request bodies were documented as "Not applicable" | Fixed: each shape is documented as an option with its own field table |
| readOnly fields listed as request fields; writeOnly fields in response examples | Fixed in the generator, and the check now flags both |
| Enums for body fields dropped; nested objects shown only as "object" | Fixed: allowed values are listed, and nested fields appear as `parent.child`, two levels deep |
| Error responses left as "Needs SME input" | Fixed: descriptions come from the spec, including shared `$ref` responses, with an example error body |
| The check passed made-up query parameters, invalid enum values, status codes not in the spec, and wrong Required flags | Fixed: all four are now errors. Parameter tables were not being compared at all before; they are now |
| An empty `owner: ""` passed | Fixed: empty required frontmatter fields fail (except in this repository's own templates) |
| `api_version: "n/a"` with `--specs` passed silently | Changed: still allowed for docs that describe no endpoint, but the result now says how many docs used it |
| CI passed green when nothing was checked; `init` did not create `openapi/`, `generated/`, `docs/` | Fixed: `init` creates them; CI fails until there is a Markdown doc to check |
| `docs/installation.md` described the old clone-and-copy install | Fixed: rewritten around the CLI |
| Borrowed path example value; default `owner: "docs-platform"`; "Platform API API Overview"; auth descriptions dropped | Partly fixed: values are no longer borrowed from nested fields of other objects; owner defaults to `unassigned` with a warning and a new `--owner` option; title fixed; scheme descriptions included. A top-level field with the same name in the operation's own request body is still used as the path example. |
| "warning(s) above" printed above its list; a stray ",,"; CI described as PR-only | Fixed |

Found while fixing: the spec's own `requestToken` example leaves out the required `nonce`. The generator now adds missing required fields from the schema and says so in the doc.

Not changed: example value types are not checked against the schema (the README says so).
